data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): ACLI returns no pageToken (it slices a cached full list). Test B's 'same-token-twice' premise has no real token to compare. Rewrite Test B to: stub returns 10 consecutive 100-issue pages and an 11th 100-issue page — assert SilentTruncationError raised with reason indicating cumulative>=1000 cannot be proven safe (e.g., reason='unverifiable-under-1000' or equivalent). Update AC grep to match the chosen reason string.
